# Stack registry & outlines (`.claude/stacks/`)
- Every declared dependency has a row in `.claude/stacks/README.md` › `## Stacks`. [guard: N1]
- Each row names an outline (`lib/<stack>.yaml`) or `none (utility)`. [guard: N2]
- `lib/` is portable (no repo paths, no statuses); this repo's adoption lives in `usage/`. [guard: N3]
- Views in `view/` are generated by `stacks.sh view`; never hand-edit one. [guard: N3]
- Registry `mcp:` tokens are wired in `.mcp.json`; `skill:` tokens are locked. [guard: N4, N5]
- Scouted deps sit behind one importer (choke point) with a lint ban. (per-project guard: N7)
- Outline facts come only from docs fetched that session; fetch an entry's ref before coding.
- Outlines change only in the /feature Learn step or the weekly `stacks_refresh.sh` branch.
- Unregistered libs are shared outlines synced from the template; adopt one by adding its row.
- Full grammar (row cells, lib/usage keys, coverage, staleness): `.claude/stacks/SCHEMA.md`.
- Run all checks with `.claude/skills/feature/scripts/stacks.sh guards`.
